w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: Word gets around the haven. Whatever that thing was — the haven's talking about nothing else.
Back at the haven the argument starts: Ananya is calling it "Ugly-Eyes." Nobody agrees yet — weigh in if you want.

★ IDENTIFIED: Dog Rose Hip. Rose hip. Bright red-orange oval fruits on the thorny rose canes. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Identification complete. You are 0.3% less lost.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (19/12/7), with 8 wave-4 fought, 20 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Ruby Callaghan ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

withdrawal.line: ◈ THE TABLE — the ring of pale light flickers at the edge of the sky... and does not come. The System does not apologize this time. "WE PRICED THE RUN. NO HUNGER ON THE RECORD — THE PELLET HUMS WHERE THE FIRE SHOULD BE. NO FEAST, NO SURGE, NOTHING HERE WE CAN PRICE. A COLD SPOT AT EVERY TABLE: THE WORDS WERE ON THE WRAPPER." The ledger still wants: the food-thesis deeds (no feast can carry the surge while the pellet hums). The mantle may pass to hungrier hands; the table will still be here.
